operations.summary: Batch lookup of companies by symbol or Company id in one query. Read-only despite the PUT verb. Each entry follows the same rule as `company/{id}`: a 24-hex ObjectId matches `_id`, anything else matches `symbol` case-insensitively, excluding Low-liquidity ETFs. Results keep request order; duplicates collapse and unknown entries are dropped. Pass `fields` to project only those fields (e.g. skip `weekly`, `financialSummary`, `description`).
